title: Appraisal Order Final Inspection Charge: Closing-Turn Part
content:
**Closing-turn part of the Appraisal Order final inspection charge.**

The closing-turn part of the final inspection charge reads the closing scheduled for the loan file and counts calendar days from today to its scheduled closing date: 0 to 5 days adds the report type's rush fee, 6 to 10 days adds 50 percent of that rush fee, and a later date or no scheduled closing adds nothing. The closing read is the Closing and Funding engagement on the Mortgage Loan File the order supports whose status is scheduled, and the date is its scheduled closing date (the date the signing is scheduled). Half the rush fee is kept to the cent. The closing-turn part is added to the final inspection charge. The closing-turn part is a turn-time premium inside the final inspection charge; it is not a rush charge on the order, which is still charged only when the borrower asks for rush at order.

| Calendar days from today to the scheduled closing date | Adds |
|---|---|
| 0 to 5 | The report type's rush fee |
| 6 to 10 | 50 percent of the report type's rush fee |
| 11 or more | Nothing |
| No Closing and Funding engagement in scheduled status on the file | Nothing |

| Report type | Rush fee (0 to 5 days) | 50 percent of rush fee (6 to 10 days) |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Exterior-Only Appraisal (Form 2055) | 100.00 | 50.00 |
| Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073) | 150.00 | 75.00 |
| Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) | 150.00 | 75.00 |
| Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA) | 150.00 | 75.00 |
| Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) | 200.00 | 100.00 |
| Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) | 250.00 | 125.00 |

*Hypothetical readings, Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA):* signing scheduled 5 days from today adds 150.00; 6 days, 75.00; 10 days, 75.00; 11 days, nothing.
